name: cortado
title: Cortado
description: Keep your PC from sleeping, indefinitely or on a timer, using PowerToys Awake
author: kusogejp

commands.name: toggle-awake
commands.title: Toggle Awake
commands.subtitle: Cortado
commands.description: Turn keep-awake on or off. Turning on uses your Toggle Behavior preference.

commands.name: keep-awake-for
commands.title: Keep Awake for…
commands.subtitle: Cortado
commands.description: Keeps the PC awake for a chosen duration via PowerToys Awake

commands.name: awake-status
commands.title: Awake Status
commands.description: Shows the current keep-awake state in this command's subtitle. Open once after installing to enable automatic updates.

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Default Duration
preferences.description: Prefills "Keep Awake for…" and is used by "Toggle Awake" when Toggle Behavior is set to "For the Default Duration".

preferences.name: keepDisplayOn
preferences.title: Display
preferences.description: Prevents the display from turning off while keep-awake is active.
preferences.label: Keep display on

preferences.name: toggleBehavior
preferences.title: Toggle Behavior
preferences.description: When Toggle Awake turns keep-awake on: stay awake indefinitely, or for your Default Duration.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
